context.en: This relief from Longmen’s Central Binyang Cave commemorates Xiaowen around 522–523, after his death in 499. The procession shows the later court’s Buddhist remembrance of the ruler who moved the capital to Luoyang in 493–494.
context.zh: 这件龙门宾阳中洞浮雕约作于522—523年，在孝文帝499年去世后纪念他。礼佛行列呈现后世朝廷对这位493—494年迁都洛阳的统治者的佛教纪念。

context.en: This Chenghua cup (1465–1487) demonstrates the combined underglaze and overglaze decoration of later Ming court ceramics. Its date belongs to that production history, not to the disputed establishment of the imperial factory.
context.zh: 这件成化杯（1465—1487年）展示明代宫廷瓷器釉下与釉上装饰的结合。其年代属于这段生产史，并非御器厂争议中的始建日期。
